notes.title: Seal of Confession is now Sainthood: Confession
notes.content: [p]Howdy folks! It's been a little quiet around here, so here's a fresh announcement! I've rebranded Seal of Confession and brought it under the Sainthood banner as [b]Sainthood: Confession.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44012236/962bd86967f595dee90f85f41e83854aed8c105d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Why?[/p][p][/p][p]Because my mission is to build games that bring the super heroes of the faith, the saints, into modern consciousness, and so any future games I make that feature a "collection" of saints will be brought under the Sainthood banner.[/p][p][/p][p]So what's this game about?[/p][p][/p][p][b]Sainthood: Confessions is a poker-like deck builder about using poker hands to build and chain devastating combos with powerful synergies.[/b][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44012236/3f29c0c1b76b578c9da74b2ff961e3f084979a69.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Poker-like Gameplay[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Build poker hands, bend the rules with saints and relics, and unleash holy combos. Find the perfect card synergies to bring absolution to souls with cinematic flair.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44012236/962bd86967f595dee90f85f41e83854aed8c105d.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Unlock the saints[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Combine saints, relics, and blessings for powerful synergies.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44012236/c63e4f4918cf5bf8a60e6ed0490ac19f5ba5ef7a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]A Dance with Sin[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Watch out for[b] SIN cards![/b]​ They are functionally useless and only serve to clog your deck over time! You must purge them from your deck before they overwhelm you.​ I'm sure there's a real-life analogy here...[/p][p align="start"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44012236/bb64fad15bca56f3c98e091d6cb8c221e932a948.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Unique Bosses[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Face off against the 7 Deadly Sins that switch up the gameplay in challenging ways![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44012236/e77a1a54b8dffffa399fcac7a222e97da17b3c9c.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Folk Horror Narrative[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Inspired by [i]Heart of Darkness[/i],[i] [/i]and a true story my mother told me, the game unfolds through daily journal entries, encroaching dread, and a deadly final confrontation.[/p][h2][b]Immersive Setting[/b][/h2][p align="start"]Set in the thick jungles of 1885 southern Nigeria, experience a unique narrative told purely through text and sound design. You set out with hunters, porters, a scout, cook, catechist, and healer. Each night by the campfire, one steps forward to confess. It's your sacred duty to bring their soul to salvation—or damnation.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"]Please go check it out and [b]Wishlist[/b]! Your continued support means the world to me and my vision![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3974320/Sainthood_Confession/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p align="start"][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2639080/Sainthood_Confession/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: ekklesia - A minimalist abstract strategy game
notes.content: [p]Hi folks! As you know, I've been playing around with a few prototypes, and I figured I would publish this one.[/p][p][i][b]ekklesia[/b][/i] is a short, meditative strategy game about growing the Church. [/p][p]It's inspired by the incredible work the apostles and their disciples did during the dawn of Christianity.[/p][p]Please go check it out and let me know what you think. It's only a short prototype, but your feedback is crucial as I continue to experiment with gameplay mechanics and ideas rooted in our faith.[/p][p][/p][h3]Play here: [/h3][p][url="https://bisong.itch.io/ekklesia"]https://bisong.itch.io/ekklesia[/url][/p][h3][/h3][previewyoutube="Rv9dc-7xkAc;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Seal of Confession Announcement
notes.content: [p]Hi everyone![/p][p]My mother once told me a story of how, when she was a kid, there was a European priest who took a trip from her village to another, but got lost in the jungles of Southern Nigeria. [/p][p]So I'm making a text-based "Confession Simulator" where you play as a priest and listen to Confessions and must assign the appropriate penance. [/p][p]The story takes place in the jungles of south eastern Nigeria in the late 19th century, and is partly inspired by the dread of Heart of Darkness. [/p][p]Please check it out, Wishlist and Share![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2639080/Seal_Of_Confession/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: New Milestone!
notes.content:
Dear friends,

Sainthood has now officially welcomed over 2,500 players into acts of faith, hope, and charity.

From the bottom of my heart: thank you for stepping onto the island, for lending your time, your curiosity, and your spirit to this little world we built. Your support means the world to me.

I created Sainthood simply because I wanted a cozy faith-based game to exist, and to put a positive light on what it means to be Catholic.

To see so many of you embrace it — and to see so many beautiful reviews (over 95% positive on both Steam & Xbox!) — is a blessing I don't take for granted. Please, keep those reviews coming! It really helps the Steam Algorithm and helps me make a better game!

✨ What's next?
I'm taking it one step at a time — fixing bugs, adding to the Prayer Mode, and exploring new ideas both within and outside the game (charity/sponsorships, anyone?).

If you’d like to follow along, come join the Discord! https://discord.com/invite/3NZdTqDVda

Thank you again for believing in this project.

See you on the island,
- Bisong.

notes.title: Rejoice, CP punishment has been reduced!
notes.content:
Hi Friends!

This one is short and simple. I've made a few tweaks and balance changes under the hood regarding CP, so hopefully it should be a bit easier to attain the ever so elusive "Canonized" achievement.

Enjoy! 😇

notes.title: Prayer Mode is here!
notes.content:
Dear Friends,

I'm excited to introduce Prayer Mode, a new way to experience Sainthood completely separate from the main game. In this mode, you can immerse yourself in the Rosary. Take a peaceful and reflective break from delivering packages and spend some time in prayer.

📿 What’s New?
✅ All 20 mysteries of the Rosary
✅ Fully voiced with music and ambience for deeper immersion
✅ Pray in one of several locations from the game

Simply select "Prayer Mode" from the main menu, and off you go!

Whether you're here for the gameplay or seeking a quiet moment of prayer, I appreciate your support, and I hope this addition brings something special to your day. Thank you for being part of Sainthood!

🙏 As always, let me know your thoughts in the Discord!

notes.title: You can now skip Provisions!
notes.content: Yep! As requested, you can now choose to [b]NOT [/b]pick one of the provisions if you don't like either of the options, or if you have a full inventory and don't want to swap out a provision you have invested into.

notes.title: Library of the Divine Achievement Fix
notes.content:
Wondering why this achievement wasn't unlocking even though you had collected all Ancient Manuscripts?

Wonder no more! The achievement has been patched. You just need to grab 10 more manuscripts ;)
